description: Create a Digital Terrain Model (DTM/MDT) from survey points in TopoCal. TopoCal is open with a pre-saved project file containing 204 survey points (UTM Zone 13N, Colorado foothills area, elevations 1718–2458m) already imported and visible in the drawing area. Create a triangulated irregular network (TIN) terrain model from these points. In TopoCal's Spanish menu interface: look for the 'MDT' menu and select the option to create or calculate the MDT ('Calcular MDT' or similar). The operation should triangulate all the survey points to form a terrain surface mesh. After creation, you should see the triangulated mesh connecting the survey points in the drawing area.
